theorem lg_target {Ω : Type u_1} {m : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ] {X : Ω → ℝ} {a b t : ℝ} (hm : AEMeasurable X μ) (hb : ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂μ, X ω ∈ Set.Icc a b) : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (t * X ω)) μ := by
  have h_bound : ∃ c > 0, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, |Real.exp (t * X ω)| ≤ c := by
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hb
    have : ∀ ω, |Real.exp (t * X ω)| = Real.exp (t * X ω) :=
      by intro ω; simp [Real.exp_nonneg]
    rw [this] at hb
    rcases hb with ⟨c, hc⟩
    use c
    exact hc

  have h_integrable : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (t * X ω)) μ := by
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := h_bound
    let this : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, |Real.exp (t * X ω)| ≤ c := hc.2
    refine' MeasureTheory.integrable_bounded_by_const _ _
    · exact this
    · exact (MeasureTheory.finite_measure_iff_isFiniteMeasure.1 (inferInstance : MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ)).isFinite
  exact h_integrable
